pages.text: Right-click one of your own maids to copy her model into the doll. Using the bound doll afterwards makes you fall over as that maid's ragdoll - the perfect way to feign death.

Lying down, right-click with the doll to toggle control mode. While it is on you can still walk, jump and fight as a ragdoll; while it is off you simply lie there. Sneak + use clears the stored model.$(br2)While riding the ragdoll, press $(k:key.sablemaidragdoll.open_emoji) to pick an emote, which is then shown above it.
Sneak + right-click on a block places the bound doll as a decoration. Breaking that block gives the doll back.
